'''Nerit''' was one of the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. It was temperate, with a varied ecosystem and gravity 125 percent of the standard. A [[Unidentified Neti clan|clan]] of expatriate [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] lived there.<ref name="GATORW109" />
